opportunities.title: Especialista en Ventas y Atención al Cliente para Med Spa
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un especialista en ventas y atención al cliente con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y experiencia comprobable en el cierre de ventas. El objetivo principal es convertir leads generados por campañas publicitarias en citas y clientes para nuestra clínica de medicina estética en Miami. Ofrecemos tratamientos faciales, corporales, rejuvenecimiento, inyectables y otros servicios estéticos. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen: - Contactar proactivamente a los leads a través de llamadas, audios y mensajes de WhatsApp. - Realizar un seguimiento constante y personalizado a cada persona interesada. - Explicar detalladamente nuestros servicios, promociones y beneficios. - Manejar objeciones de manera efectiva y persuadir a los interesados para que agenden citas. - Gestionar y actualizar la información de los leads en nuestro sistema CRM. - Brindar una atención al cliente cálida, profesional y personalizada en todo momento. Buscamos a alguien que posea: - Experiencia demostrable en ventas y cierre de negocios. - Habilidad excepcional para comunicarse por teléfono. - Capacidad para persuadir sin ejercer presión sobre el cliente. - Ser una persona organizada, proactiva y constante en su trabajo. - Experiencia previa en clínicas estéticas, Med Spas o servicios de belleza será altamente valorada. - Dominio del español es indispensable; el inglés es una ventaja. - Disponibilidad para trabajar durante el horario laboral. Es fundamental que la persona tome la iniciativa, realice llamadas, haga seguimiento y se enfoque en conseguir resultados, no solo en contestar mensajes. Nosotros proporcionaremos los leads y la capacitación necesaria sobre nuestros servicios. Las recomendaciones médicas y la determinación de tratamientos son responsabilidad de nuestros profesionales clínicos. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Comercial / Vendedor Tamaño del proyecto: Grande

opportunities.title: Build Bilingual AI Real Estate Sales Agent
opportunities.description: Developer Needed: AI Automation Engineer to Build an Intelligent Sales Agent for a US Real Estate Company PRESTIA AI | Fixed-Scope and Fixed-Price Execution Contract 1. Executive Summary PRESTIA AI invites AI and automation developers and specialized firms to submit technical and financial proposals to implement a fully operational Intelligent Sales System for a real estate company in Florida, USA. The project aims to develop an intelligent sales agent supporting both English and Spanish. The agent will engage with leads, qualify and categorize them, record their data in a CRM system, book appointments, send confirmations and notifications, and escalate cases requiring human intervention to designated staff. PRESTIA AI seeks a fully integrated, testable, maintainable, and scalable solution, not merely an experimental chatbot or demo prototype. The system must be well-documented, secure, manageable, and independent of the developer's personal account. 2. Project Objectives The project aims to: Improve response times to prospective leads. Provide effective automated conversations in English and Spanish. Collect, qualify, and classify lead data according to approved business rules. Log lead details and interactions into the CRM system. Automate appointment scheduling and dispatch confirmations/notifications. Minimize lost sales opportunities and optimize follow-up management. Establish a clear escalation protocol for complex cases requiring human intervention. Build a scalable system designed for future operations, maintenance, and expansion. 3. Scope of Work 3.1 Multilingual AI Agent The bidder must design and implement an intelligent sales agent with the following functionalities: Conduct conversations, qualification, follow-ups, and appointment bookings in English and Spanish. Automatically detect the lead's language and respond accordingly, while allowing manual language selection. Handle incoming inquiries via website and official WhatsApp Business channels. Rely strictly on verified company, real estate, and service information to prevent hallucination of prices, specs, or availability. Collect and qualify lead data based on custom rules provided by PRESTIA AI. Maintain conversation context and lead data during language switching or transition between qualification and booking stages. Escalate unsupported inquiries or complex scenarios to human representatives based on clear routing logic. 3.2 CRM Integration & Appointment Management Scope includes: Capturing leads and logging key interactions into the designated CRM. Creating and updating records while preventing duplicate entries caused by re-triggered events. Integrating with calendar systems (e.g., Google Calendar) to verify real-time availability prior to confirming bookings. Preventing double-booking and sending bi-lingual scheduling confirmations/notifications to responsible teams. Supporting cancellations and rescheduling if included in agreed terms. 3.3 Technical Integration & Automation The bidder must build required integrations across: Website & lead collection forms WhatsApp Business API (official provider) CRM & Calendar systems Notification channels Technical requirements: Implement error logging and automatic retry mechanisms for failed API calls. Secure API keys, enforce proper access controls, and safeguard lead data. Deliver a system fully operational, manageable, and maintainable without reliance on personal developer accounts. Low-Code/No-Code platforms, custom APIs, or off-the-shelf AI services may be used provided they fulfill requirements, offer ease of management, and document all costs clearly. Note: All tools, CRM selections, integration methods, and estimated operational fees must be disclosed upfront. No paid additions or subscriptions may be purchased without prior written approval from PRESTIA AI. 4. Live Demo & Pre-Selection Prototype Shortlisted candidates must deliver a Live Demo or limited prototype demonstrating core functionality in both English and Spanish, including: Live conversations with language auto-detection and manual switching. Lead qualification, data capture, and mock/live CRM record creation. Real-time availability checking and appointment confirmation. Graceful handling of unknown data and seamless handoff to human agents. Evaluation focuses on data accuracy, context retention, and functional execution rather than UI aesthetics alone. Full project work will not be built for free; demo scope, duration, and any nominal costs must be agreed upon in advance. 5. Key Deliverables The bidder must deliver: Fully operational, production-ready system per agreed scope. English/Spanish AI Sales Agent operating under specified workflows. Complete automation flows, custom code, and configuration files (flagging non-exportable components). Live integrations across Website, WhatsApp, CRM, Calendar, and Alerts. Technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and workflow maps. User operations & troubleshooting guide for routine maintenance and setting updates. Itemized breakdown of software tools, API subscriptions, and operational expenses. Verified testing reports proving successful execution in both languages. Formal handover session and practical training. Transfer of all system access rights, accounts, and configuration files according to ownership agreements. 6. Acceptance Criteria & Testing Prior to development, testing scenarios and pass criteria will be defined in writing. Testing must cover: Bi-lingual interactions via Web and WhatsApp. Lead qualification, CRM record generation, and deduplication logic. Valid booking flow, calendar synchronization, and conflict rejection. Automated alert dispatches and human handoff routing. Error recovery, API retry behavior, and security access controls. Project acceptance requires written approval from PRESTIA AI after passing all test benchmarks. 7. Timeline, Pricing & Payment Terms Timeline: Bidder must provide a realistic milestone plan covering development, testing, and handover. Pricing: Fixed total price for execution, strictly separating developer fees from third-party operational/subscription costs. Payment Terms: Tied directly to reviewable, milestone-based deliverables. Scope Changes: Scope adjustments require prior written approval for both cost and extended timeline. 8. Warranty & Technical Support 90-Day Warranty: Includes a 90-calendar-day warranty period starting from final written acceptance to fix bugs, settings, or broken integrations at no extra cost. Exclusions: Excludes new feature requests, scope changes, or third-party service outages unrelated to original implementation flaws. opportunities.title: Experto en Despiece y Diseño Detallado de Mobiliario para Fabricaci...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional experto en despiece de mobiliario para generar planos detallados y listos para la producción en carpintería. El proyecto implica tomar las medidas y el diseño del mobiliario deseado, y transformarlo en una representación técnica completa que incluya absolutamente todos los detalles necesarios para su construcción. Esto abarca la especificación de conexiones, tipos y ubicaciones de tornillos, soportes, herrajes y cualquier otro componente. El objetivo es proporcionar un documento técnico claro y comprensible que la carpintería pueda utilizar directamente para la fabricación, asegurando precisión y eficiencia en el proceso. opportunities.title: App Bíblica Multiplataforma
opportunities.description: Deseo desarrollar una aplicación que permita leer la Biblia por libros y capítulos de forma clara y cómoda en dispositivos Android y iPhone. Alcance principal • Pantalla de selección de libro y capítulo con navegación intuitiva. • Lectura fluida del texto bíblico, con opción de ajustar fuente y modo oscuro. • Marcadores y favoritos básicos para que el usuario retome fácilmente su lectura. • Sincronización de progreso entre Android e iOS usando un backend ligero (Firebase o similar). • Publicación en Google Play y App Store, listas para descarga. Qué espero recibir – Código fuente completo y bien documentado. – Paquetes instalables (APK y archivo IPA/TestFlight). – Breve guía de despliegue y mantenimiento. Para tu propuesta Envíame una propuesta detallada del proyecto que incluya la arquitectura sugerida, tecnología recomendada (React Native, Flutter o nativo), fases de trabajo y tiempo estimado. También agradezco enlaces a proyectos similares si los tienes. Busco una solución robusta pero sencilla, lista para iterar en futuras versiones con planes de estudio y devocionales.

opportunities.title: FiveM Enhanced MLO/YMAP Developer — Conversion, Conflict Resolution, Consolidation, Optimize and In-Game Testing
opportunities.description: Fixed total budget: USD 500 for the agreed full scope, not per group. We need an experienced FiveM mapping developer to prepare our existing YMAPs and associated assets for FiveM Enhanced. This project covers existing map files and their required models, textures, collisions, archetypes, occlusion and LOD data. It does not involve general framework development, gameplay systems or creating new interiors from scratch. You must already have a working GTA V Enhanced installation, FiveM Enhanced test environment, CodeWalker and the required conversion tools before accepting. Required work 1. Convert assets for FiveM Enhanced - Convert applicable Legacy models and textures using FiveM Alchemist or an appropriate verified workflow. - Preserve the required YMAP, YTYP, collision and other supporting map data. - Verify that the resulting assets load correctly in FiveM Enhanced. - Report conversion failures or unavailable source files promptly. Conversion logs or a folder named stream_enhanced alone do not establish completion. 2. Merge and organize map resources Consolidate the supplied maps and assets into: - x6-businessmaps - x6-shadowmaps - x6-governmentmaps - x6-housingmaps - x6-jobmaps - x6-leisuremaps - x6-worldmaps - x6-mapdata for agreed shared mapdata and compatibility files. The target is one working map resource per category, with a correct top-level manifest, required registrations and an organized streaming structure. Identify any technical or asset-protection restriction before proceeding. Do not simply move unchanged individual resource folders under a category folder and describe them as merged. 3. Resolve map and asset conflicts Identify and resolve: - Duplicate filenames with different contents. - Conflicting map definitions and archetypes. - Overlapping placements and map edits. - Collision, occlusion, LOD and streaming conflicts. - Conflicts between category groups and shared mapdata. Removing duplicate filenames is not necessarily conflict resolution. Preserve the required changes from each affected map. Do not select a conflicting version solely by alphabetical order, load order or file size. Document the resolution and validate it in game. Do not remove maps, replace businesses or choose between overlapping alternatives without our approval. 4. Repair and optimize Within the agreed asset inventory: - Fix missing models, props and textures. - Address texture loss, flickering, incorrect collisions and visibility issues. - Review and repair LODs, draw distances, map bounds and lighting where needed. - Optimize textures and models where justified, preserving acceptable visual quality. - Clean unnecessary files from the delivery. - Verify compatibility when all supplied groups run together. Any required UK-style texture or signage changes must be listed against specific assets before the fixed scope is agreed. In-game validation is mandatory Before submitting a category as completed: - Load it on a working FiveM Enhanced test server. - Visit every included map location. - Check models, textures, collisions, lighting and visibility. - Inspect repaired areas from different distances and angles. - Check relevant server/client errors and streaming warnings. - Test it with its required map dependencies. Before final delivery, test all completed categories together. For performance claims, provide before-and-after measurements using the same hardware, settings, locations and conditions. CodeWalker inspection, automated reports and videos of files opening are not substitutes for FiveM Enhanced testing. AI and automation may assist the work, but the developer remains responsible for inspecting and validating the results. Scope and delivery We will agree a dated inventory of included maps/assets, required repairs, exclusions and delivery dates before implementation. We may initially share only a small batch for qualification. Further groups follow after that batch is validated. The initial batch does not redefine the full-project budget. Work document: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1flO2glbX3TW3HPoyxrFSscfGvPfFdJvmt8ExuxPz6NI/edit?gid=860763218 Each delivery must include: - One ZIP containing complete installation-ready resource folders. - Correct manifests and required map files. - Installation instructions, dependencies and start order. - A file-level change list and conflict-resolution record. - A per-location test checklist with relevant in-game screenshots or recordings. - A clear list of any unresolved issues. Blocked or untested work must be identified as incomplete. Do not silently delete assets or return an untested pack as finished work. General server/framework development and unrelated scripts are outside scope. Existing asset dependencies must be identified and preserved; any required script changes must be raised before implementation. Your proposal must confirm 1. Your experience with FiveM Enhanced YMAPs and associated assets. 2. That your game, tools and test environment are already operational. 3. How you resolve conflicting collision and occlusion files. 4. How you verify conversion and test every supplied map location. 5. Your delivery schedule for the qualification batch, remaining groups and final combined test. 6. That you have reviewed the inventory and can complete the agreed scope for USD 500, with any exclusions stated before acceptance. Relevant experience and verifiable results are required. Generic bids will not be considered.

opportunities.description: I have a working 3D concept for a folding-screen phone and now need a highly realistic dummy unit—exactly the kind you see on display in retail stores—for upcoming product photos or videos. I will supply the rough design files so you can refine, fabricate, and finish the model. Surface quality is critical: the body, hinge area, cameras, buttons, and bezel all have to stand up to close-up shots without betraying that it is a mock-up. Functionally, the hinge must fold smoothly and every external button should move convincingly, though no electronics are required. Preferred workflow is up to you—CNC, high-resolution SLA, multi-material FDM, or a combination—so long as the result feels solid in hand and the gap at the fold aligns cleanly. A realistic screen graphic or dummy glass layer would be a plus. Deliverables • One fully assembled, photo-ready dummy phone that folds and has working buttons • Any updated CAD or build notes created during the process • A short video clip proving the hinge action before shipping Ship the finished piece safely packaged to my address (to be provided after award). I’m looking to get started right away and can answer technical questions or supply extra reference images as soon as we connect.

opportunities.title: Taxi Service Website Development
opportunities.description: I run a small auto-taxi business focused on local city rides and I need a clean, fast website that lets potential passengers do two things before anything else: see my phone number instantly and click a WhatsApp button to start a chat. A built-in price estimator is also essential so visitors can check an approximate fare before they decide to call. Design can stay simple—one to three pages is fine—but it has to look good on mobile because most customers will be on their phones. If you can add a lightweight price calculator (distance-based or zone-based; I’m open to suggestions) and prominent “Call Now” and “Message on WhatsApp” buttons, the core job is done. Online booking forms are not required right now, though I may add that later. Deliverables: • Responsive website (HTML/CSS/JS or a lightweight CMS) • Fare estimator integrated and tested • Click-to-call and WhatsApp chat links placed prominently • Basic SEO setup for city-ride keywords • Hand-off with all source files and brief instructions for small text or fare updates Once it’s live I’ll handle hosting and domain myself; just point me to the best setup. Let me know what tech stack you prefer and any content you’ll need from me to get started.

opportunities.title: MS Teams to Zendesk Ticketing Automation
opportunities.description: Brief: Teams Customer Chasers → Zendesk Automation Oct 21, 2026 · @Edwin Objective Automatically turn customer chasers posted in Microsoft Teams group chats into tracked, prioritised actions on the matching Zendesk ticket. Agents keep working only from Zendesk; Teams becomes one more signal feeding the operational queue. Today, chasers arrive in Teams and must be spotted, matched and acted on manually. The target behaviour: customer chases in Teams → the right ticket is identified from PNR, ticket number or subject → it is marked as chased → it rises in a dedicated Zendesk view. Architecture Customer chaser in Teams → automation captures message → extracts PNR / ticket no. → searches Zendesk → matches ticket → updates it via Zendesk API → native Zendesk trigger → Customer Chasers view → agent action. • Why not the standard Zendesk for Teams app: it lets agents view, create and update tickets in Teams, but does not auto-match chasers or reprioritise tickets. • Division of labour: the automation performs the external Teams → Zendesk update; native Zendesk triggers handle routing and priority afterwards. Zendesk warns against triggers calling webhooks back into the same ticket (race conditions). • Message capture: every new customer message in the relevant Teams group chats must be captured in near real time, through a dedicated operations/service Teams account that is a member of every customer chat. • Identity: OAuth credentials on a dedicated integration identity for production, never personal credentials. Zendesk setup (before building the flow) Custom field Type Purpose Teams Chaser Checkbox Flags tickets chased on Teams Teams Chaser Count Number Chaser events received Last Teams Chaser Date/time Latest chase; drives duplicate suppression Teams Match Status Dropdown Auto Matched / Manual Match / Unmatched PNR Text Matching key (confirm it already exists) Tags: teams_chaser (matched), teams_unmatched_chaser (exceptions). Add tags additively so existing tags are not overwritten. Views: • Customer Chasers — Teams Chaser = Yes. Columns: Ticket ID, Subject, PNR, Status, Assignee, Chaser Count, Last Chaser. Grouped 3+ chasers, then 1–2, then normal queue; normal SLA order within each. • Unmatched Teams Chasers — tag teams_unmatched_chaser. The safety net. Automation requirements For every new customer message, the automation must: 1. Capture the message from the customer Teams group chat as it arrives. 2. Clean it to plain text (strip Teams HTML formatting). 3. Extract the PNR: the 6 characters after PNR:, spaces removed (e.g. PNR: ENIPEC → ENIPEC). Version 1 handles explicit PNR: only. 4. Extract the ticket number after TKTN: (e.g. 978-7493167546). Keep multi-ticket strings such as 160-7363702923/21/22/24 whole for now. 5. Retain the full message text for subject/request-type matching. 6. Search Zendesk tickets for the PNR (Search API, type:ticket ). 7. Evaluate the results (0, 1 or 2+ plausible tickets) against the matching rules below. 8. opportunities.title: SolidWorks/AutoCAD Production Model Drafting
opportunities.description: I have a mechanical product that is moving toward production and now need clean, editable CAD files created in SolidWorks and exported to AutoCAD. The goal is a production-ready model, but at a “basic components and assembly” level—think overall geometry, clear interfaces, and straightforward exploded views rather than full tolerance stacks or exhaustive material call-outs. Here is what I am looking for you to hand over: • A complete 3D assembly in SolidWorks (.sldasm + .sldprt) • 2D assembly and part drawings in both SolidWorks drawing format and DWG for AutoCAD • An exploded view or simple assembly sequence so our shop team can see how everything fits File naming must be logical, each part mated properly, and the assembly should open with no missing references. As long as the model reflects correct fit and function, you can keep the detailing light; I will add tolerances and materials in-house later. If you are comfortable switching between SolidWorks and AutoCAD and can turn around a tidy, well-organized CAD package, let’s get started—I’m ready to review your first draft as soon as it’s ready.

opportunities.title: Build Headless Shopify Activewear Store
opportunities.description: Project Posting: Full-Stack Shopify Plus / Headless Developer for D2C Technical Activewear E-Commerce Store (Radian Theme Aesthetic) Project Budget: Fixed Price / Milestone-Based (Competitive market rates based on proven portfolio) Project Timeline: 6 to 8 Weeks Location / Remote: Remote (Global / Asynchronous with regular milestone syncs) Project Overview We are launching a high-performance, direct-to-consumer (D2C) technical activewear brand. We require an elite Full-Stack E-Commerce Developer / Agency to build a lightning-fast, conversion-optimized storefront from the ground up. The aesthetic benchmark for this build is the Radian theme style: an ultra-dark, brutalist industrial look featuring high-contrast monochrome (pitch black #000000, charcoal #121212, sterile white #FFFFFF), flatlock inverted contrast seams, gothic/blackletter typography, and raw utilitarian performance gear presentation. The architecture will leverage Shopify Plus / Headless (Next.js front-end connected to Shopify Admin & Storefront APIs) backed by PostgreSQL/Supabase and automated 3PL logistics middleware. Key Deliverables & Scope of Work 1. Front-End Development (Next.js / Tailwind CSS / Radian Theme UI) Design System Implementation: Build a custom, high-performance UI matching the brutalist industrial aesthetic (pitch black/monochrome, custom typography, zero layout shift). Dynamic PDP (Product Detail Page): Sticky Add-to-Cart bar with instant variant switcher (Size: S-XXL, Fit Profile: Oversized / Compression). Interactive Technical Spec Sheets (GSM weight breakdown, 4-way stretch nylon-mesh fabric details, care instructions). Immersive full-screen media grids and macro photo galleries. PLG & Collection Grids: Lightning-fast product listing pages with instant filtering, sorting, and low-stock badge indicators. 2. Shopify Integration & Backend Architecture Shopify Storefront API Integration: Full headless connection for dynamic cart management, checkout redirection, and inventory sync. Variant Matrix & Bundling: Setup multi-attribute variants and custom kit builder logic (e.g., bundle compression top + 350 GSM joggers with automated bundle discounts). Supabase / PostgreSQL Database Setup: Implement auxiliary data tables for User Fit Lockers (saving height, weight, fit preference), VIP waitlists, and custom customer profiles. 3. Checkout, Payments & Regional Gateways Express Checkout Optimization: Seamless integration for Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay, and UPI Intent flows (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm). Payment Gateway Integration: Razorpay / Cashfree integration supporting Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, UPI, and verified Cash on Delivery (COD) workflows to mitigate RTO (Return to Origin). Multi-Currency Support: Geo-IP currency detection (INR, USD, EUR, GBP). 4. Logistics, 3PL & Fulfillment Automation Courier Aggregator Middleware: Integrate Shiprocket / Delhivery / Blue Dart APIs. Automated AWB & Manifest Generation: Webhook-driven order routing that triggers label generation and shipping status updates upon payment capture. Branded Tracking & Returns Portals: Custom /pages/track portal for real-time milestone tracking and an automated self-serve return/exchange module. 5. Marketing, Tracking & Performance Optimization Analytics & CAPI: Server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and Google GA4 event tracking (PageView, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase). Klaviyo Integration: Abandoned cart flows, browse abandonment, and restock alert webhooks. Performance Benchmark: Deliver a Lighthouse performance score of 95+ with optimized image loading, edge caching, and bot-mitigation rate limiting. Technical Stack Requirements Front-End: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion. Commerce Backend: Shopify Admin GraphQL API, Shopify Storefront API. Database & State: PostgreSQL (Supabase), Redis (Caching & Rate Limiting). Hosting & CDN: Vercel Enterprise, Cloudflare DNS. APIs: Shiprocket/Delhivery logistics APIs, Razorpay/Cashfree payment gateways, Klaviyo, Meta CAPI. Ideal Candidate / Agency Profile Proven Portfolio: Must showcase live Shopify Plus, headless Next.js, or high-end apparel/streetwear/activewear stores with exceptional design execution (dark mode, brutalist, or minimalist luxury aesthetics). API & Webhook Mastery: Deep experience handling complex Shopify webhooks, inventory syncing, and third-party logistics (3PL) API integrations. Performance Obsessed: Demonstrated ability to build blazing-fast web apps with optimized Core Web Vitals. Communication & Code Standards: Clean, well-documented code repositories (GitHub), adherence to strict version control, and transparent milestone reporting. Application Requirements When applying, please provide: Links to 2–3 live, production-grade e-commerce stores you have built (specifically highlighting Next.js/Headless Shopify or high-aesthetic apparel brands). A brief overview of your technical approach to handling headless Shopify architecture and inventory synchronization. Your estimated timeline and milestone breakdown to complete this scope.

opportunities.title: AI CRM to Boost Ceramic Sales
opportunities.description: I run a ceramic manufacturing business in Morbi and my biggest pain-point is missing out on hot enquiries. I want a custom CRM powered by AI that captures leads the moment they appear, nudges them automatically, and keeps my sales team organised so we close more deals—faster. Lead capture must be truly omnichannel: • Website forms and live chat on our corporate site • WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram messages or lead ads • Dealer enquiries and trade-fair visitor lists • Direct email enquiries that land in our shared inbox Once a lead enters the system the CRM should: • Enrich and score it with AI so high-value prospects surface first • Trigger personalised follow-ups (email or WhatsApp) at smart intervals • Hand the conversation to a human agent when required, logging every touchpoint • Provide a single dashboard with filters for source, status, probability and salesperson • Generate clear reports so I can see which channels and reps are performing best I’m open to the tech stack—whether you prefer a no-code backbone like Zoho/HubSpot customised with scripts, or a ground-up build using Node, Python, or similar—as long as integrations are stable and the UX is lightweight enough for field reps on mobile. Deliverables I need to sign off: 1. Working cloud CRM with all above channels live in production 2. AI scoring & automated follow-up workflows demonstrated on test data 3. Sales dashboard with exportable reports 4. One-hour handover session plus concise user guide When you apply, just share past work that proves you’ve built multi-channel CRMs or similar marketing automations before. No lengthy proposals—let your portfolio speak. If your experience lines up, we’ll jump on a quick call to map timelines and milestones.

opportunities.title: Custom WordPress Affiliate Deals Website
opportunities.description: WordPress Developer Needed for a Deals & Savings Website I am looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a modern, responsive, affiliate deals website featuring discounts from multiple retailers. I already have a homepage design reference. I need you to implement the existing design, not create a new one from scratch. Required Features * Custom WordPress website that closely follows my design reference. * User-friendly admin dashboard to manually add, edit, and manage deals without coding. * Custom deal fields: product name, image, retailer, current price, original price, discount percentage, SKU, affiliate link, category, and expiration date. * Automatically display published deals on the homepage, relevant retailer pages, category pages, and search results. * Automatically hide expired deals from active listings. * Individual product deal pages with a clear “View Deal” button. * Search and filtering by retailer and category. * Mobile-friendly design, SEO optimization, and fast loading speed. * Affiliate disclosure and outgoing affiliate click tracking. Future Expansion The website should be structured to support future affiliate API integrations and deal automation. Automation is not required for the initial launch and should not be included in this quote. Requirements * Strong experience with custom WordPress development. * Ability to create custom functionality beyond standard themes and plugins. * Full website ownership, source code, and administrator access. * Deployment, testing, and basic documentation included.

I already have every image and video edited, titled, and sorted; no production work is needed—just packaging and promotion. If you’re comfortable connecting content creators with the right audience and can move quickly, let’s talk and get this live.

opportunities.title: Local SEO for Delhi Tuition Agency
opportunities.description: Title: Local SEO Expert Needed: Home Tuition Agency, Delhi NCR (Milestone-Based) About us Home Guru Tutors is a home tuition agency in Delhi NCR. We send verified tutors to students' homes for school subjects and JEE/NEET preparation. We want to grow enquiries from parents through organic search. Goal Rank for hyperlocal searches like "home tutor in Dwarka," "class 10 maths home tuition Noida," and "NEET biology tutor Gurgaon," and turn that traffic into calls, WhatsApp chats, and demo-class bookings. Scope of work website creation (technical SEO, speed, mobile, indexing) Keyword research and a locality-wise plan for Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Ghaziabad Google Business Profile optimization (service-area business) and a review-collection process Location + class/subject landing pages (10-15 in phase 1), with unique, non-templated content Schema markup, sitemap, Search Console and GA4 setup, conversion tracking for calls, forms, and WhatsApp clicks Parent-focused blog content plan (topics, briefs, and optional writing) Citation/directory listings (Justdial, Sulekha, UrbanPro, etc.) with consistent name, address, and phone Monthly reporting focused on enquiries and rankings by locality Deliverables and milestones Phase 1 (weeks 1-2): Website Creation, keyword/locality plan, tracking setup Phase 2 (weeks 3-6): Business Profile, first 10-15 location pages, technical fixes Phase 3 (months 2-3): blog content, citations, review process, reporting Requirements Proven local SEO results, ideally for service, education, or tutoring businesses Experience with Google Business Profile and multi-location pages White-hat methods only. No bulk or purchased backlinks. Clear communication and monthly progress calls Please include in your bid 2-3 case studies with before/after rankings and enquiries (links preferred) Your plan for the first 30 days. Which tools you use, and whether reports and accounts will be shared with us Price for each phase, and your monthly retainer after the 3 months Your estimate of realistic timelines (no guaranteed rankings) Any references we can contact Terms Milestone payments. We will own all accounts (website, Search Console, GA4, Business Profile). 3-month initial engagement with a review point. Bids that guarantee #1 rankings or promise bulk backlinks will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Digital Trifold Brochure PDF Creation
opportunities.description: I have a fully designed, six-panel tri-fold brochure, along with an existing interactive HTML prototype that already displays the panels in the correct sequence. I am not looking for a new brochure design or a standard PDF conversion. I'm looking for someone who can take my existing artwork and HTML prototype and create a polished, interactive digital brochure that opens and closes naturally, like a physical tri-fold leaflet. What I need: The brochure should initially display the front cover. On the first click, the cover should open to reveal two panels side by side. On the second click, it should unfold fully to reveal the three inside panels. On the final click, it should close to display the back cover. The folding movements should look smooth and realistic. All existing artwork, text, photographs and branding must remain unchanged. The finished brochure must work on desktop and mobile devices. It must be accessible through a simple web link that I can share by email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn. I would like the finished HTML/source files so I can make future updates. I can provide the original PDF artwork and the existing working HTML prototype, so the developer will not need to start from scratch. Budget: €30 initially. Please advise if the animation requirements make this unrealistic. I'm looking for someone experienced in HTML5/CSS/JavaScript animation who can show examples of similar interactive projects. Please include at least one example of past work relevant to this project.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40789830, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 8 - 30.

opportunities.title: Monetized Celebrity News Channel Automation
opportunities.description: I’m building a celebrity-and-entertainment news channel with one clear objective: consistent revenue from YouTube ads. To get there, I need an end-to-end partner who can take each video from idea to “Publish” without me lifting a finger. Here’s the workflow I want you to own: • Research trending celebrity or entertainment stories, then craft engaging, retention-friendly scripts (around 6–8 minutes each). • Record natural-sounding voiceovers, add royalty-free background music, and edit into dynamic, fast-paced videos using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or CapCut. • Upload finished videos to the channel, writing SEO-smart titles, descriptions, and tags, and designing clickable thumbnails in Photoshop or Canva that are optimized with TubeBuddy/VidIQ insights. Expectations • 3–5 uploads per week to start, scaling once RPM and watch-time metrics prove profitable. • Content must be 100 % original: no reused footage, AI voices, or copyrighted music. • Thumbnails maintain a consistent brand style and <2 MB file size. • All scripts, project files, and assets are delivered to me in a shared Google Drive folder for transparency. If you’ve successfully grown ad-revenue channels in this niche, send a couple of links plus a brief outline of your typical turnaround time. Let’s turn trending headlines into steady AdSense income together.

opportunities.title: Automatización NBA 1Q en Google Sheets
opportunities.description: TÍTULO DEL PROYECTO: Google Sheets automatizado con API NBA: tablas por cuarto, cálculo de total y hándicap del 1er cuarto DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PROYECTO: Necesito un archivo de Google Sheets totalmente automatizado para analizar apuestas de la NBA, centrado en el primer cuarto (1Q). No tengo conocimientos técnicos. El freelancer debe encargarse de toda la configuración, conexión, fórmulas y puesta en marcha. Mi único trabajo diario será abrir el archivo, pulsar actualizar, escribir la línea de la casa de apuestas y leer el resultado. No quiero copiar y pegar datos ni tocar fórmulas. PARTE 1: CONEXIÓN AUTOMÁTICA A UNA API GRATUITA DE LA NBA Usar una API gratuita y estable, preferiblemente ESPN (endpoints públicos sin clave) o balldontlie.io (tier gratuito). El freelancer puede elegir la que considere más fiable y debe documentar la URL usada. Al pulsar un botón o abrir el archivo, el script de Apps Script debe refrescar automáticamente estas tablas: 1. Partidos del día: equipos, fecha, hora y estado del partido. 2. Boxscore por cuarto: puntos de cada equipo en 1Q, 2Q, 3Q y 4Q. Es imprescindible que traiga los puntos de ambos equipos en cada partido, no solo de uno. 3. Estadísticas por jugador: jugador, equipo, minutos, puntos y faltas, filtrable por cuarto si la fuente lo permite. 4. Tabla de referencia de los 30 equipos, generada automáticamente desde la API o precargada una sola vez. No debo escribirla a mano. PARTE 2: CÁLCULOS AUTOMÁTICOS DEL PRIMER CUARTO El freelancer debe dejar montadas las fórmulas para que, dados los últimos 15 partidos de cada equipo, la hoja calcule sola: · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo A. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo A (puntos del rival en esos mismos partidos). · Media de puntos anotados en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Media de puntos permitidos en 1Q por el Equipo B. · Puntos esperados de A = (media anotada de A + media permitida de B) / 2. · Puntos esperados de B = (media anotada de B + media permitida de A) / 2. · Total 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A + puntos esperados de B. · Hándicap 1Q esperado = puntos esperados de A − puntos esperados de B. La ventana móvil debe ser configurable (por defecto 15 partidos), para poder cambiarla sin tocar fórmulas. PARTE 3: COMPARACIÓN CON LA LÍNEA DE LA CASA Y SEMÁFORO DE VALOR En una hoja de Resultados debe haber: · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Total 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una columna vacía para que yo escriba la línea de Hándicap 1Q de la casa de apuestas. · Una celda que calcule la diferencia entre mi estimación y la línea. · Un semáforo automático con formato condicional: verde si la diferencia absoluta es de 2 puntos o más (POSIBLE VALOR), rojo si es menor (SIN VALOR). Lo mismo para el total y para el hándicap. PARTE 4: INTERFAZ SENCILLA Una hoja Resultados donde se vea claramente, para el partido del día: · Equipos que juegan. · Total 1Q esperado. · Hándicap 1Q esperado. · Línea de la casa (la escribo yo). · Diferencia y semáforo de valor. · Alertas si falta una estrella, un pívot clave o un creador de juego, si la fuente de datos lo permite. El resto de hojas pueden ser de datos, configuración o históricos, pero no quiero tener que tocarlas. PARTE 5: ENTREGABLES · Archivo de Google Sheets completamente funcional y compartido con permiso de edición. · Script de Apps Script incluido y documentado. · Breve guía de uso de 1 a 2 páginas: cómo actualizar, dónde escribir la línea, qué significa cada columna y cada semáforo. · Prueba de funcionamiento con al menos un partido real: que el total y hándicap del 1Q calculados coincidan con los datos oficiales, y que el semáforo responda correctamente al cambiar la línea. · Video de 2 minutos o llamada corta mostrando cómo se actualiza el archivo, dónde se escribe la línea y cómo cambia el semáforo. REQUISITOS DEL FREELANCER · Experiencia demostrable en Google Sheets, Apps Script, conexión a APIs y JSON. · Conocimiento de la NBA y de mercados de apuestas como totales, hándicap y primer cuarto es un plus. · Debe encargarse de toda la implementación técnica. Yo no puedo programar ni configurar conexiones. · Debe entregar el sistema estable y documentado para que no requiera mantenimiento por mi parte. PRESUPUESTO Y PLAZO · Presupuesto orientativo: 80–150 USD. · Plazo deseado: 1–2 semanas. · Acepto hitos de pago: uno al validar la conexión y las tablas de datos, y otro al entregar los cálculos del 1Q, el semáforo y la guía final. NOTA No busco un producto genérico de apuestas, sino una herramienta concreta para el primer cuarto de la NBA. No espero garantías de rentabilidad, solo una herramienta técnica bien construida, estable y sin mantenimiento por mi parte. Si la fuente de datos cambia en el futuro, el freelancer debe dejarlo documentado para poder actualizarlo fácilmente. HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS Google Sheets, Apps Script, API, JSON, Sports Betting, NBA, Data Automation.

opportunities.title: STL Model Reshape for Printing
opportunities.description: I have an existing 3D model in STL format that needs several changes before it will be ready for the printer. The piece must be resized to exact specifications, certain features have to be added or removed, and the surfaces need a material-quality pass so I can generate realistic colour previews prior to fabrication. Your task is to open the current STL, carry out those geometric edits cleanly, refine any visible texture detail, and return a watertight, non-manifold-free file that slices without errors. Feel free to work in the software of your choice—Blender, Z-Brush, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or similar—as long as the final delivery meets the following acceptance criteria: • Updated, print-ready STL at the correct scale • Clean topology: no holes, inverted normals or intersecting shells • Added/removed features blended seamlessly into the mesh • Optional high-res OBJ (or equivalent) with improved material/texture data for preview renders Let me know the tools you plan to use and your expected turnaround time, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Ongoing 3D Video Editing
opportunities.description: I have a steady pipeline of marketing and narrative pieces that call for cinematic, photoreal 3D animation. On each project you will be responsible for building or refining scenes, applying realistic textures, setting up dramatic lighting, choreographing camera moves, and delivering final, fully rendered footage that matches an approved reference. opportunities.title: Figura 3D caricatura personalizada
opportunities.description: Necesito un modelo 3D listo para impresión que represente una figura decorativa basada en las fotos que te entregaré. Quiero un estilo simple, caricaturesco y amigable, sin llegar a la hiper-realidad: proporciones exageradas, rasgos simplificados y una pose dinámica que destaque la personalidad del sujeto. Te enviaré varias imágenes de referencia (persona, mascota u objeto) para que captes los puntos clave y mantengas la esencia. Trabajo principalmente con impresoras FDM, así que el diseño debe contemplar: • Partes optimizadas para evitar soportes excesivos. • Grosores mínimos adecuados para una boquilla de 0,4 mm. • Separación clara de piezas, si fuera necesario para prevenir warping o facilitar el pintado. Entregarás: 1. Archivo fuente editable (Blender, ZBrush o similar). 2. STL limpio, escalado a 150 mm de altura. 3. Capturas o pequeño turno de revisión por si hay que ajustar expresión, pose o base. Busco alguien que disfrute del estilo cartoon y tenga experiencia exportando modelos sólidos, sin mallas abiertas ni errores de geometría. Si ya imprimiste tus propios diseños, menciona qué software usas para confirmar compatibilidad con Cura/PrusaSlicer. Quedo atento a tu propuesta y a un pequeño portafolio que demuestre trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Static 5-Page Trade Fair Website
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a straightforward, brochure-style website to promote an upcoming B2B exhibition and I need the complete package—design, build, and launch—within a fixed budget of ₹3,500. Scope of the site • Five static, fully responsive pages: Home, About the Exhibition, Exhibitor Details, Visitor Details, and Contact. • Exhibitor Details page must showcase the current exhibitor list and exhibition categories, each with a prominent “Enquire on WhatsApp” button so prospects can message us instantly. • Visitor Details page is strictly informational; visitors only need to read about the event and click the same WhatsApp link if they have questions. No registration forms are required anywhere on the site. Essential integrations & setup • Click-to-chat WhatsApp link visible on every page. • Domain registration, hosting configuration, and creation of two business email addresses (e.g., info@ and sales@). • Basic SEO tags (title, meta description, alt text) and Google-friendly sitemaps. • Lightweight code with fast load times; no CMS or databases necessary. Deliverables 1. Finalised UI mock-ups for approval. 2. Hand-coded HTML/CSS/JS files (or a simple static-site generator if you prefer). 3. Domain pointed to live hosting, SSL activated. 4. Two working business email inboxes. 5. Documentation covering how to update text and images plus WhatsApp number changes. Acceptance criteria • All links, buttons, and email addresses tested and working. • Site renders correctly on modern desktop and mobile browsers. • Page speed score above 85 on Google PageSpeed Insights. • Project handed over in full within the agreed budget, with no recurring licence costs beyond hosting. If this matches your skill set and timeline, I’ll share the exhibition branding assets so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Travel Agency SEO & Marketing Strategy
opportunities.description: I have just launched my travel company and need an experienced SEO and digital-marketing partner to put it on the map—literally on Google—for one specific country. My goal is to identify promising products, launch efficiently, and generate profitable sales through a data-driven advertising strategy.

opportunities.title: Cinematic 3D Video Creator Needed
opportunities.description: My upcoming slate of marketing and brand films calls for a partner who can take a storyboard and turn it into a fully-realised, cinematic 3D sequence with characters and environments that feel alive on screen. You should be comfortable handling every stage of the shot—from blocking the scene, lighting, texturing and animating, right through to the final render and post-polish—while carefully matching any reference footage I supply. For each project I will provide: • a written brief, mood-boards and timing references • any existing assets or logos that must be incorporated • the delivery schedule and required resolution (usually 4K) What I need from you: • a short reel or links that highlight comparable cinematic work • the primary software you work in (Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini, 3ds Max, etc.) and any plug-ins you rely on • your ballpark price or day rate for projects of this scale Consistency is key; I’m aiming to build a long-term collaboration, so reliability, clear communication and a passion for visual storytelling count just as much as technical skill. If you thrive on crafting movie-like moments in 3D and can keep quality high across multiple releases, let’s talk about the first scene.

opportunities.title: Remote Order Tracking Assistant
opportunities.description: We're a logistics company, and we're looking for an assistant to help track shipments and keep customers informed. The work is practical: checking where each shipment is, updating our records, and sending short updates to customers using templates we provide. Most tasks follow the same steps, so once you've done a few, the process becomes familiar. We care more about accuracy and consistency than about experience in logistics. If you're careful with details, can follow a procedure, and notice when something doesn't match, you'll fit in well. Training takes about an hour, and we review your first updates before you work independently. You'll flag delayed or missing shipments to the team lead with a short note, and keep the tracking sheet clean and up to date. opportunities.title: Luxury Fragrance Packaging CAD Design
opportunities.description: We are developing a new luxury fragrance collection and are looking for an experienced 3D CAD/product and packaging designer to take our existing concepts through to physical prototyping and ultimately factory-ready production files. We already have the overall creative direction, mood boards, sketches, visual references and dimensional guidelines. We are not looking for someone to create the brand identity from scratch. We need someone who can refine our existing designs, perfect the proportions and details, and translate the concepts into technically accurate designs suitable for sampling and manufacturing. The project covers the complete luxury fragrance presentation: • 100ml glass perfume bottle • Custom decorative cap, collar and pump integration • Individual perfume presentation box • Luxury gift box • E-commerce/mailing box • Luxury shopping/gift bag Bottle & Components The perfume bottle is a custom design and will require careful refinement of its shape, proportions and construction while maintaining the intended luxury aesthetic. The designer should understand the technical considerations involved in fragrance bottle manufacturing, including internal volume, glass thickness, neck and pump compatibility, cap and collar construction, tolerances, moulding requirements and decorative details such as embossing/debossing. The bottle, cap, collar and pump should work together as one properly engineered product. Perfume Presentation Box We already have the visual direction for the individual perfume packaging. The designer will need to translate this into a practical luxury packaging structure, including the correct dimensions, internal bottle support, opening experience, materials, embossing/debossing, foiling and other premium finishes. Final production-ready dielines will be required. Luxury Gift Box We require development of a premium gift box that complements the perfume packaging and provides a strong luxury unboxing experience. This will include the structural design, proportions, opening mechanism, internal presentation/insert system, materials, finishes and production-ready dielines. Mailing / E-commerce Box The mailing box should continue the luxury experience while providing sufficient protection for delivery. The designer should develop the structure, dimensions and internal arrangement required to hold and protect the fragrance packaging securely during shipping while maintaining the premium presentation of the brand. Luxury Shopping / Gift Bag The shopping bag should also form part of the same cohesive packaging family. This will require appropriate dimensions, materials, reinforcement, handles or ribbon, branding placement and luxury finishing details, together with production-ready specifications and artwork/dielines. Phase 1: Design Development & Prototyping The first stage will involve refining the existing designs and producing the 3D models, renders, technical drawings and files necessary for physical samples/prototypes to be produced. We want to review the complete presentation physically before final manufacturing, so accuracy of dimensions, proportions and construction is important. High-quality realistic renders should also be provided during development so that materials, finishes, colours and overall presentation can be reviewed before prototypes are commissioned. Phase 2: Factory-Ready Development Following review of the physical samples, any necessary adjustments will be made before preparation of the final production files. Final deliverables should include, where applicable: • STEP/STP and/or IGES CAD files • STL files for prototyping where required • Editable/source CAD files • 2D manufacturing drawings with dimensions and tolerances • Material specifications • Surface and finishing specifications • Component/assembly information • Production-ready packaging dielines • Press-ready PDF files • Any other technical files reasonably required by the relevant manufacturers All final source and production files created for the project must be provided upon completion. Who We Are Looking For We are particularly interested in designers with genuine experience in: • Perfume/fragrance bottle design • Cosmetic or luxury glass packaging • Premium rigid packaging • Luxury beauty packaging • High-end retail and e-commerce packaging • Taking products from concept and CAD through physical prototyping and into manufacturing This is not simply a CGI or 3D rendering project. We need someone who understands the relationship between beautiful luxury design and the technical realities of manufacturing. When applying, please provide examples of relevant previous work, particularly fragrance, cosmetic, glass or luxury packaging projects that have actually progressed into physical production. Please also confirm: • Which CAD/design software you use • Your experience with glass bottle and luxury packaging manufacturing • Whether you can produce both prototype and factory-ready files • Your estimated timeframe for the initial design development • The number of revisions included • Your proposed fee for the complete scope We are looking for someone who is highly detail-oriented, understands luxury aesthetics and can work collaboratively with us through design refinement, sampling, revisions and final production. The objective is to create a complete fragrance presentation that feels considered and luxurious at every stage, from the bottle in the hand to the box, gift presentation and final delivery experience.

opportunities.title: Production-Ready Aerospace CAD Design with Prototype Assembly
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a seasoned CAD engineer who can take on an end-to-end aerospace package. The scope spans traditional aircraft structures and brackets, engine or other mechanical components, and a full range of unmanned-aircraft parts—from the primary frame to propellers, motor mounts, landing gear, payload mounts, and electronics enclosures. My goal is to walk away with production-ready data, so your work must include: • Detailed 3D models of every part that are editable • Fully-dimensioned manufacturing drawings suitable for CNC, additive, or composite lay-up routes • A clean assembly model that shows precise fit and clear bill-of-materials relationships I typically review native files in SolidWorks or CATIA and neutral formats (STEP, IGES) for shop use, but I’m open to NX or Fusion 360 if that’s where you work best—just let me know up front. Acceptance criteria: • All models pass interference and tolerance checks at ±0.1 mm • Drawings conform to ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards • Assembly opens error-free in my SolidWorks 2023 verifier session If you have a proven track record in aerospace or UAV design and can hit these marks without hand-holding, I’d like to hear how you’d approach the project and see a sample that illustrates a similar complexity level.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40789549, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 1,500 - 3,000.

opportunities.title: YouTube Automation Production Partner - Long Term Collaboration
opportunities.description: Hi, We’re looking for a long-term video production partner to help us offer affordable YouTube automation services to our clients. IMPORTANT: You must already have a working production system or a proven, semi-automated process. We are NOT looking to build a new system from scratch. REQUIREMENTS: 1. Existing system or process: You use AI, automation (such as n8n), templates, or other tools to produce videos quickly and at low cost. 2. Proven experience: You have experience using your system or process and can show real examples of your work. 3. Bulk production: You can handle 50–100 videos per week and you can scale up if needed. 4. Multiple video styles: Ideally, you can offer all the styles below: o Stock videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1WVB2HFXIBw o AI animations (realistic and 3D): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kvY_E2utAxs https://www.youtube.com/shorts/owP74YWfuSM o 2D template animations: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SlY8eIRwkr8 o Stick figure animations: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VTXQ5anjDkU o Spokesperson animations: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZG4we9JTZ9I 5. Reseller prices: You can offer the package prices listed below. • 1 long video + 1 short per week – $5 per week • 3 long videos + 3 Shorts per week – $15 per week • 7 long videos + 7 Shorts per week– $35 per week HOW THE PARTNERSHIP WORKS We will promote and sell these services to our clients and forward orders to our selected production partner(s). This is a long-term partnership, not a one-time project. Please note this is a new service so the order volume we can offer is unknown. To apply. please start your bid with “Partnership” and answer these questions: 1. Do you already have a working automated video production system or a proven process for producing videos in bulk? Briefly explain how it works. 2. Which of the video styles listed above can you offer? 3. How many videos can you produce per week? 4. Can you provide the packages at our target prices? 5. Can you and your system or process handle the full workflow, including ideas, scripts, AI voice-overs, visuals, subtitles, thumbnails, SEO, YouTube uploads and quality control? 6. Please share real examples of videos produced using your existing system or process. We look forward to finding a reliable partner for a long-term collaboration.

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Finance Icon Library
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a professional 3D artist to create a comprehensive and realistic 3D finance icon library. The library should include a variety of finance-related symbols. Key Requirements: - Include all three categories: - Money and payment icons (e.g., coins, banknotes, payment methods) - Banking and card icons (e.g., bank buildings, credit/debit cards) - Charts and investment icons (e.g., growth charts, stock market symbols) - Visual Style: Realistic and detailed Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in 3D modeling software (e.g., Blender, Maya, 3ds Max) - Strong portfolio showcasing realistic 3D icons or similar work - Attention to detail and ability to create high-quality, visually appealing icons - Experience in finance-related designs is a plus Please provide samples of your previous work and an estimated timeline for completion.

opportunities.title: Prueba y ajuste formulario Wix
opportunities.description: Tengo una web en Wix (editor Harmony) con una colección del CMS llamada “Talentos” que alimenta la página Talentos y el Directorio de Talentos. Necesito que los datos y la foto que los usuarios envían en el formulario de Registro de Artistas lleguen a esa colección. * Situación actual: - Los formularios funcionan y me llega el aviso por correo. - Los envíos NO pasan al CMS. El soporte de Wix me confirmó por escrito que Harmony no permite vincular de forma nativa los archivos o imágenes de Wix Forms con colecciones del CMS. - En Harmony no tengo modo desarrollador ni Velo. Propuesta de solución (abierto a otras mejores): formulario ---- automatización (Make o Zapier) ---- CMS. No quiero migrar a Wix Studio salvo que sea imprescindible y se me justifique técnicamente, con presupuesto previo. * FASE 1. Prueba de viabilidad (1-2 horas, precio fijo). Antes de hacer nada más, necesito comprobar que esto es posible en mi sitio. Objetivo: Enviar un formulario de prueba y verificar que el texto Y la imagen llegan a un elemento de la colección “Talentos”. Al terminar, quiero un informe breve con: - Si funciona o no, y por qué. - Cómo se resuelve el tema de la imagen. - Si Harmony lo permite o hace falta otra vía (y cuál). - Precio cerrado y plazo de la fase 2. * FASE 2. Implantación (solo se la fase 1 es positiva). 1. Cada envío (texto+imagen) crea un elemento en “Talentos”. 2. La imagen se guarda correctamente en el campo de imagen. 3. Revisar que la página de Talentos y el Directorio apunten a esa colección y muestren foto, disciplina, categoría, email y texto. 4. Guía breve de cómo funciona, para poder mantenerlo yo. * Condiciones: - Alcance cerrado a este flujo, con presupuesto fijo por escrito para cada fase. - Pruebas en una copia del sitio. - Valorable experiencia demostrable con Wix CMS y Make/Zapier (portfolio o reseñas). Si te interesa, indícame precio de cada fase, plazo y cómo lo harías. Si crees que no es posible en Harmony, dímelo claramente y explica por qué. Gracias, Miguel Angel.

El diseño debe ser práctico y fácil de fabricar con medios convencionales. Valoro que me expliques brevemente tu enfoque, plazos estimados y ejemplos previos realizados en Inventor y AutoCAD.

opportunities.title: Surat-based digital marketer (AI + lead funnels) for diamond and jewellery idea tests
opportunities.description: Title: Surat-based digital marketer (AI + lead funnels) for diamond and jewellery idea tests About us We are a diamond and jewellery business in Surat. We want to test 5 new ideas quickly and cheaply before building anything big. Each idea gets its own landing page and a small ad test. This is a smoke test: we want to know which ideas get real enquiries. What you will do Set up and run small paid tests on Meta (Instagram, Facebook) and Google, with a separate campaign for each idea. Use AI tools to create landing pages, ad copy and creatives fast. We already have draft pages. You can improve them or build new versions to test. Build a simple lead funnel: landing page, WhatsApp enquiry, lead sheet, and follow-up for people who do not reply. Install tracking (Meta Pixel, Google tag, GA4) so every enquiry is counted by idea and source. Keep cost low. Tell us where you would spend and where you would not. Give a weekly report and a clear recommendation: which idea to scale, fix or stop. How we will judge the work Number of real enquiries and cost per enquiry for each idea Enquiry to paid-signal rate Likes, views and clicks are only supporting numbers. We will not pay for or judge on likes alone. You must have Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads Experience building lead funnels and landing pages, with examples Working knowledge of AI tools for copy, creative and automation (please name the tools you use) Growth testing mindset: small budgets, fast changes, honest results Based in Surat, available to meet in person Nice to have: diamond, jewellery or luxury experience. Ground rules Ad accounts and pixels stay in our name. You get access, not ownership. No fake likes, bought followers or bot traffic. Ad spend is separate and paid by us directly to the platforms. To apply, send 2 or 3 past projects with real numbers (enquiries or leads, not just reach) Your plan for the first 2 weeks The AI tools you would use and why Budget: [3000] Duration: setup 1 to 2 weeks, test 4 weeks

opportunities.title: Acreditación ISO 17025 en CDA
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo y un equipo para lograr acreditar y poner en marcha un laboratorio de metrologia en Colombia enfocado en CDA logrando acreditarse ante la ONAC Es necesito realizar una auditoría de lo que se tiene de lo que falta corregir analizar y implementar 1. Diseño e implementación del Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC): Documentar procedimientos técnicos, metrológicos y administrativos alineados con la ISO/IEC 17025. Definir la política de calidad, control de documentos, gestión de riesgos y manejo de no conformidades. 2. Aseguramiento de la Trazabilidad Metrológica: Calibrar tus equipos patrón en laboratorios que ya estén acreditados por ONAC o en institutos nacionales de metrología reconocidos internacionalmente (como el INM en Colombia o laboratorios firmantes del acuerdo ILAC). 3. Cálculo e Estimación de la Incertidumbre de Medición: Desarrollar los modelos matemáticos y presupuestos de incertidumbre (bajo la guía GUM) para cada uno de los métodos de calibración que vas a ofrecer. 4. Validación y Verificación de Métodos: Demostrar mediante pruebas técnicas que tus procedimientos de calibración son confiables y repetibles. 5. Participación en Ensayos de Aptitud (Intercomparaciones): Debes participar y tener un desempeño exitoso en rondas de ensayos de aptitud o comparaciones interlaboratorios con otros laboratorios acreditados para demostrar competencia técnica. 6. Solicitud ante el ONAC: Registrarte en el sistema SIPSO de ONAC, radicar la solicitud de acreditación para el esquema de Laboratorios de Calibración (LAC) especificando tu alcance (las magnitudes y rangos exactos que certificarás). Superar las auditorías del ONAC: Etapa 1 (revisión documental del SGC) y Etapa 2 (auditoría in situ en tu laboratorio para evaluar la competencia técnica del personal y la ejecución de las pruebas). 7. Cierre de hallazgos y Otorgamiento: Atender las no conformidades (Plan de Correcciones y Acciones Correctivas - PCAC) si las hay, hasta que el comité de ONAC apruebe la emisión de tu certificado de acreditación oficial.

opportunities.title: Gestión de Ventas WhatsApp

Requiero disponibilidad comprobable durante el horario comercial de mi país y experiencia previa atendiendo ventas por WhatsApp. Si ya has usado herramientas como etiquetas, mensajes automáticos o catálogos dentro de WhatsApp Business, menciónalo: suma muchos puntos.

opportunities.title: Multiagente Redes Sociales Integrado
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar un multiagente capaz de atender de forma automática los mensajes que llegan por WhatsApp, Instagram y Facebook Messenger. El objetivo principal es que el sistema responda de manera natural y coherente a: • Preguntas frecuentes sobre nuestros productos o servicios • Consultas relacionadas con ventas y pedidos • Solicitudes de soporte y resolución de problemas Cuando el bot no pueda resolver una consulta, deberá transferir la conversación a una persona de mi equipo sin pérdida de contexto. Busco una solución que incluya: – Integración estable con las API oficiales de los tres canales mencionados. – Motor de procesamiento de lenguaje que permita respuestas personalizadas y consistentes. – Lógica de enrutamiento inteligente para identificar cuándo derivar al equipo humano. – Panel o dashboard básico para que podamos supervisar conversaciones, añadir respuestas y actualizar flujos. Entrego la documentación de marca y las FAQ existentes; tú te encargas de configurar, entrenar y probar el modelo para que quede listo para producción. Valoraré experiencia previa con bots multicanal, WhatsApp Business API, Meta Graph API y buenas prácticas de hand-off a agentes humanos.

opportunities.title: Closer de Servicios de Alto Valor
opportunities.description: Si sabes vender, igual esto te interesa ! Buenas, voy al grano. En ViralBee vendemos páginas web y posicionamiento en Google a empresas. Nada especialmente raro. Hay negocios que necesitan más clientes, nosotros les ayudamos a conseguirlos y alguien tiene que venderlo. Ahí entras tú. Buscamos comerciales que sepan moverse, hablar con empresarios y cerrar ventas. Gente que prefiera salir a vender antes que pasarse el día hablando de vender. ¿Y qué hay para ti? Pues comisiones de entre el *25 % y el 40 % por venta*. Los servicios que vendemos están entre los *1.500 € y los 2.500 €*. Haz números. Una venta puede dejarte entre *375 € y 1.000 € de comisión*, dependiendo del importe y del porcentaje que tengas acordado. Y no, no necesitas venderle una web a tu primo, a tu cuñado ni a tu vecino el del quinto. La idea es trabajar con negocios y empresas que puedan necesitar nuestros servicios. Si tienes experiencia como comercial, eres closer o simplemente sabes vender y crees que puedes cerrar operaciones, me gustaría hablar contigo. Sin entrevistas eternas. Sin historias raras. Hablamos, te cuento cómo funciona y vemos si tiene sentido para los dos. *Si te interesa, escríbeme* Y si conoces a alguien que sea bueno vendiendo, pásaselo. Igual le acabas de alegrar el mes. Un saludo, *ViralBee*

opportunities.title: Asesor Comercial Corporativo B2B
opportunities.description: Busco un asesor comercial experimentado que pueda hacerse cargo de todo el ciclo de ventas: • Conseguir nuevos clientes • Atender y cerrar ventas con clientes interesados • Gestionar cuentas y fidelizar clientes actuales El foco será prospectar y desarrollar relaciones con pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas. Para lograrlo, necesitarás combinar llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas, correo electrónico y reuniones presenciales según convenga a cada oportunidad. Qué espero de tu trabajo: 1. Generar un flujo constante de prospectos calificados. 2. Convertir oportunidades en ventas con un proceso claro de seguimiento. 3. Mantener y ampliar las cuentas existentes, identificando oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling. 4. Reportar semanalmente el estado del pipeline, métricas de conversión y acciones próximas. Valoro la experiencia previa en entornos B2B, un estilo de comunicación persuasivo y autonomía para organizar tu propia agenda. Si dominas CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar) y tienes historial demostrable de cumplimiento de cuotas, será un plus. Indica en tu propuesta: • Resultados comerciales alcanzados en los últimos 12 meses. • Sectores o nichos donde tengas mayor red de contactos. • Herramientas de ventas que manejas. Estoy listo para empezar de inmediato y evaluaré candidaturas con base en experiencia y plan de acción.

opportunities.title: Wikipedia Page Corrections & Updates
opportunities.description: I need an experienced Wikipedia editor to bring my existing page fully up-to-date and factually accurate. The priority is fixing several incorrect dates, titles, and names that have crept in over time. I can supply official documents and public records for every correction, so you will have verifiable, citable sources at hand. Scope of work • Review the current article line-by-line, highlighting each date, title, or name that conflicts with the documentation I provide. • Update the text and infobox accordingly, adding precise citations that satisfy Wikipedia’s reliable-source policy. • Ensure all edits comply with neutrality, notability, COI, and other Wikipedia guidelines so the changes stick. • Where space allows, polish wording and structure for clarity without altering tone. • Submit the revised wikitext and an edit summary I can paste directly, or, if you have an established editor account in good standing, make the live edits yourself. Success criteria • Every corrected fact matches the supporting document. • References are formatted properly and link to the primary record. • No warnings, reverts, or flags within one week of publication. If you have a solid track record of successful Wikipedia contributions and understand the platform’s policies inside and out, I’d love to hear how you would approach this update and your estimated timeline.
